# package fxcm

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-opcua/uafx/fxcm"
```

Package fxcm is the configuration model of a UAFX ConnectionManager: OPC 10000-81 version 1.00.04, §6.7 to §6.16 and Annex F.

A ConnectionConfigurationSet comes in as the Annex F structure uafx.ConnectionConfigurationSetConf, from a file (DecodeFile, F.2) or built in Go. NewConfig validates it and turns it into an immutable Config, one per Version of the set (§6.8.2). An Edit is the transactional edit of §6.7.4: a working copy that CommitUpdates turns into the next Version.

State is the state machine of a set (§6.9), with the transitions an action may start and the event each one has. The ownership classes of the ConnectionEndpoints a ConnectionManager finds (Ownership) and the decisions over them (what a run may close, when a lost response proves an endpoint ours, when a set may be processed again by itself) are pure functions here, as are the diagnostics of §10.19 and the ConnectionState of §10.20.

The package makes no calls to a server. The design of the ConnectionManager, which the comments cite as "design §n", is docs/design/uafx-connection-manager.md (go-opcua pull request 44).

## Constants

```go
const MaxFileSize = 16 << 20
```

MaxFileSize is the largest file DecodeFile takes and EncodeFile writes: 16 MiB. Library interpretation: F.2 and F.3 set no limit; this one bounds the memory a decode of untrusted input takes.

## Variables

```go
var ErrConfig = errors.New("fxcm: configuration")
```

ErrConfig is in the chain of every error about an invalid ConnectionConfigurationSet or file.

```go
var ErrManager = errors.New("fxcm: manager")
```

ErrManager is in the chain of the errors of the ConnectionManager that are not about the content of a set, such as an edit by a client that does not hold the Lock.

## Functions

### func Activity

```go
func Activity(action uafx.FxProcess) uafx.LastActivityMask
```

Activity returns the LastActivity bit of the action (§10.30), 0 for an unknown action.

### func ConnectionStateOf

```go
func ConnectionStateOf(monitored, established bool, ep1 uafx.ConnectionEndpointStatus, ep2 *uafx.ConnectionEndpointStatus) uafx.ConnectionState
```

ConnectionStateOf returns the ConnectionState of a Connection (§10.20): NotMonitored when the ConnectionManager does not monitor it; NotEstablished when it is not established (before establishment, after removal, or when an endpoint disappeared); otherwise from the Status of its endpoints. For a Connection with two endpoints (bidirectional, or unidirectional with heartbeat, Figure 58): Initial when either is Initial, else Error when either is Error, else the lower of Ready, PreOperational and Operational. For an autonomous publisher or subscriber, ep2 nil (Figure 59): the state of ep1. A Status outside §10.17 is Error: library interpretation, fail closed.

### func DecodeFile

```go
func DecodeFile(b []byte) ([]*uafx.ConnectionConfigurationSetConf, error)
```

DecodeFile decodes the content of a ConnectionConfigurationSet file (F.2 Table F.37): a UABinaryFileDataType (Part 5 §12.31) whose Body is an array of ConnectionConfigurationSetConfDataType. The input is untrusted. An empty Body array returns no sets and no error. Any defect is ErrConfig with ua.StatusBadTypeMismatch in the chain (Table F.40). The sets are decoded, not validated: NewConfig does that.

The Namespaces of the file name the namespaces of the structures in it; Part 5 §12.31 maps its first entry to NamespaceIndex 1, and F.2 asks for [http://opcfoundation.org/UA/](http://opcfoundation.org/UA/) and [http://opcfoundation.org/UA/FX/CM/](http://opcfoundation.org/UA/FX/CM/) in it. DecodeFile requires the CM namespace and reads the Body with the indexes of Part 5. A compatibility tolerance, not a reading of F.2: when the Body does not decode that way and the first entry is [http://opcfoundation.org/UA/](http://opcfoundation.org/UA/), DecodeFile tries the indexes of a NamespaceArray (the first entry is index 0), as a writer that copies a server's NamespaceArray produces. A file without the OPC UA namespace, which F.2 asks for, is read too: index 0 is the OPC UA namespace either way.

### func Diagnose

```go
func Diagnose(name *ua.QualifiedName, action uafx.FxProcess, state uafx.ConnectionState, ep1 Outcome, ep2 *Outcome) *uafx.ConnectionDiagnostics
```

Diagnose returns the ConnectionDiagnostics of a Connection after a processing of its set with action (§10.19): the bit of the action in LastActivity, the others cleared; the Error bit when an endpoint did not succeed; per endpoint NoError and Good when it succeeded, its FxError and StatusCode when it failed, ProcessingStopped or Rollback with Good. ep2 is nil for a Connection without Endpoint2, whose fields are NoError and Good. state is the ConnectionState (ConnectionStateOf).

### func EncodeFile

```go
func EncodeFile(sets []*uafx.ConnectionConfigurationSetConf) ([]byte, error)
```

EncodeFile returns the content of a ConnectionConfigurationSet file for sets (F.2), which DecodeFile reads. Its Namespaces are [http://opcfoundation.org/UA/](http://opcfoundation.org/UA/) and the Data, AC and CM namespaces of UAFX. A NodeId in a set has the index of the Namespaces of its ServerAddress (F.1.2.2), not of the file, and is written as it is. The sets are not validated. Content larger than MaxFileSize is ua.StatusBadEncodingLimitsExceeded: DecodeFile would refuse it.

### func RetryAllowed

```go
func RetryAllowed(failures []Failure, unresolved int) bool
```

RetryAllowed reports whether a set in Error may be processed again by the ConnectionManager itself (design §5.5, decision D5): only when its last run failed, every failure of it is Transient (ProcessingStopped and Rollback follow from another failure and do not count), and the run left no Unresolved endpoint. An Unresolved endpoint stops automatic retries until a Reconcile or Settle clears it.

### func Scan

```go
func Scan(rec *EndpointRecord, obs *Observed, appURI string, preconfigured bool) (Ownership, ScanVerdict)
```

Scan returns the verdict of step 0 for an endpoint configuration that wants a preconfigured endpoint (IsPreconfigured, Table 79) or not, given rec (nil without one) and obs, the endpoint the browse found under the Name (nil when there is none), and the class of obs (Foreign when obs is nil).

### func StatusOf

```go
func StatusOf(err error) ua.StatusCode
```

StatusOf returns the StatusCode in the chain of err: Good for nil, ua.StatusBad for an error without one.

Config is one Version of a ConnectionConfigurationSet: validated and immutable. A run processes the Config it started with; an edit makes a new one (§6.7.4: only committed updates are processed).

### type EditSlot

```go
type EditSlot struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

EditSlot is the edit state of one editable set (§6.7.4): at most one Edit, owned by the holder of the Lock. The zero EditSlot is a set that is not in edit, with the Lock at the ConnectionManager (F.1.3). An EditSlot is not safe for concurrent use: the ConnectionManager serializes the calls on a set.

#### func (EditSlot) Commit

```go
func (s *EditSlot) Commit(owner LockOwner) (cfg *Config, ok bool, err error)
```

Commit is CommitUpdates (§6.7.4): the working copy becomes the next Version of the set (Version is incremented on every commit, §6.7.4 and §6.8.2) and the Lock goes back to the ConnectionManager. ok is false when the set is not in edit: the call is ignored for the set and cfg is nil. The caller must hold the Lock, else ua.StatusBadInvalidState (Table 82).

Library interpretation: an invalid working copy, or one whose BrowseName or Folder changed (the identity of the set, §6.7.2; renaming is a Replace, F.3.3.2), is a \*ConfigError and the set stays in edit with the Lock at the owner, who may correct or discard it.

#### func (EditSlot) Discard

```go
func (s *EditSlot) Discard(owner LockOwner) (ok bool, err error)
```

Discard is DiscardUpdates (§6.7.4): the updates are dropped and the Lock goes back to the ConnectionManager. ok is false when the set is not in edit: the call is ignored for the set. The caller must hold the Lock, else ua.StatusBadInvalidState (Table 82).

#### func (EditSlot) Editing

```go
func (s *EditSlot) Editing() *Edit
```

Editing returns the Edit in progress, nil when the set is not in edit (Edit FALSE).

#### func (EditSlot) LockLost

```go
func (s *EditSlot) LockLost() bool
```

LockLost ends the edit when its Lock goes for any reason, such as the end of the owner's session or an expired Lock: the set is treated as DiscardUpdates (§6.7.4). It reports whether an edit ended.

#### func (EditSlot) Start

```go
func (s *EditSlot) Start(cur *Config, owner LockOwner) (*Edit, error)
```

Start is StartEditing (§6.7.4): the set goes into edit with the Lock given to owner and a working copy of cur. When owner already holds the Lock, nothing changes and Start returns the Edit in progress. Another owner's edit is ua.StatusBadInvalidState (Table 82).

### type Ownership

```go
type Ownership int
```

Ownership is the class of a ConnectionEndpoint a ConnectionManager finds under the Name of an endpoint configuration of a set. Library interpretation (design §5.3): only a KnownOwned or TakenPreconfigured endpoint may be closed; §6.12 makes the Name unique within a FunctionalEntity, which identifies an endpoint, not who made it.

```go
const (
	// Foreign: not made or taken by this ConnectionManager. Never touched.
	Foreign Ownership = iota
	// KnownOwned: this ConnectionManager created it, by the result of its
	// call or by the proof of ResolveLostResponse.
	KnownOwned
	// TakenPreconfigured: a preconfigured endpoint the set names as
	// preconfigured and a call of this ConnectionManager took. Closing it
	// with Remove TRUE releases it; the AC keeps it (§6.2.5.2).
	TakenPreconfigured
	// Unresolved: this ConnectionManager may have made it, without proof.
	// Reported, never closed, until a Reconcile or Settle decides it.
	Unresolved
)
```

The ownership classes.

#### func Classify

```go
func Classify(rec *EndpointRecord, obs *Observed, appURI string) Ownership
```

Classify returns the class of obs, found under the Name of an endpoint configuration of a set, given rec, the record of this ConnectionManager for that endpoint configuration (nil when it has none), and appURI, the ApplicationUri of this ConnectionManager.

  - With a record of the same NodeId, the class of the record, unless the endpoint no longer matches it: a KnownOwned endpoint whose ConnectionManagerApplicationUri is another is Unresolved, and so is a TakenPreconfigured one that is no longer preconfigured, is in use by another ConnectionManager (InUse), or has another ConnectionManagerApplicationUri: another ConnectionManager may have taken it since, and §6.2.5.2 keeping preconfigured objects does not make closing its Connection safe. Unresolved is reported and never closed, so that a takeover is seen, not undone.
  - Without a matching record, an endpoint with this ConnectionManager's ApplicationUri is Unresolved (§6.6.2 names an application, not a call); anything else is Foreign.

#### func ResolveLostResponse

```go
func ResolveLostResponse(lr LostResponse, appURI string, exclusive bool) (class Ownership, absent bool)
```

ResolveLostResponse decides an endpoint after a lost response (design §5.4). absent is true when nothing was created or taken. Otherwise class is KnownOwned only when all hold: the Name was absent at step 0, the browse finds exactly one endpoint, its ConnectionManagerApplicationUri is exposed and is appURI, the (AC, FunctionalEntity) was serialized for the run, and exclusive is true: the deployment asserts that no other ConnectionManager uses appURI (§6.6.2 identifies an application, which a redundant pair or a copied configuration may share). A preconfigured endpoint is TakenPreconfigured when exactly one is found, its RelatedEndpoint is the one the call set, and nothing says another ConnectionManager uses it (InUse, another ConnectionManagerApplicationUri). Everything else is Unresolved: fail closed.

#### func (Ownership) MayClose

```go
func (o Ownership) MayClose() bool
```

MayClose reports whether a ConnectionManager may close an endpoint of the class o (CloseConnections, §6.2.5): KnownOwned and TakenPreconfigured.


ScanVerdict is what step 0 of an establish run does with the Name of an endpoint configuration (design §5.2, §5.5).

```go
const (
	// ScanCreate: nothing is there; create the endpoint.
	ScanCreate ScanVerdict = iota
	// ScanCloseFirst: a KnownOwned or TakenPreconfigured survivor; close it
	// with Remove TRUE, then create or take it again.
```

#### func Finish

```go
func Finish(s State, failed bool) (Transition, error)
```

Finish returns the transition that ends the processing of a set in the state s: ProcessingToReady when processing of all its Connections succeeded, ProcessingToError when any failed (§6.9.2). A set that is not in Processing is ua.StatusBadInvalidState.

#### func Start

```go
func Start(s State) (Transition, error)
```

Start returns the transition that starts the processing of a set in the state s: ReadyToProcessing or ErrorToProcessing (§6.9.2: transitions 1 and 4 are started by ProcessConnectionConfigurationSets or by vendor-specific means). A set in Processing cannot be processed again: ua.StatusBadInvalidState (§6.7.5.2 Table 86).
